# BeckCraft — Design Notes

Source: ColorLib Beckham (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/beckham/)
Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/beckham/
New name: beckcraft

## Structure Order

1. Navbar (sticky, nav links)
2. Hero Slider (2 slides, dark overlay)
3. About (text + CTAs + contact info)
4. Services (8 items in grid)
5. Portfolio (3 work items)
6. Counter (animated statistics)
7. Footer

## Section-by-Section Fidelity Notes

### Navbar
- Fixed top navigation
- Logo "Beckham Muff" on left
- Nav links: Home, About, Services, Portfolio, Contact
- Anchor scroll to sections

### Hero Slider
- Full-width carousel with 2 slides
- Each slide: "Hello! I'm Beckham Muff" greeting
- "I'm from Berlin" location text
- "A Web Designer" title
- Dark semi-transparent overlay on background images

### About
- "About" heading
- "Hi! I'm Beckham Muff" subheading
- Description paragraph
- "Checkout my resume" button
- "Contact me here!" link
- Contact info: email, phone number

### Services
- "My services" heading
- 8 service items in a 4x2 grid (responsive)
- Each item: icon, title
- Services: UI/UX Design, Mobile App Design, Responsive Design, Product Strategy, Design Sprints, UX Strategy, HTML/CSS, Prototyping

### Portfolio
- "Portfolio" heading
- "Checkout a few of my works" subheading
- 3 portfolio items in a row
- Each item: image, title, description
- Items: Illustration, Web Design, UI/UX Design

### Counter
- Statistics section with animated counters
- Numbers animate when scrolled into view

### Footer
- Contact information
- Copyright notice
- "Made with Component Dock" branding

## Design Token Summary

- Primary green: #79efb4 (mint)
- Secondary blue: #2f89fc
- Body font: Montserrat (sans-serif)
- Button style: pill-shaped (border-radius: 30px) or sharp (border-radius: 0)
- Page background: #f8f9fa (off-white)
- Footer background: #121212 (dark)
